required_future_gates.decision: Select the actual fault class and specify fixed and preserved valid behavior; separate local policy from unspecified upstream cases.
Define observable causal diagnosis with a fair rubric that accepts equivalent explanations and rejects misleading diagnoses independently of a passing patch.

Define minimality within the selected fault family, equivalent input representations, persistence and actual liveness of the retained regression; do not require one instructor literal or claim global mathematical minimality.

Bind the expected original subject fault to the intended actual input/call/finality. Separate it from learner/late faults, assertion, race, timeout and infrastructure failure; panic or exit 1 alone never proves reproduction.

Choose submission artifacts and assembly, editable/readonly boundaries, source/runtime freshness and migration in a separate reviewed ADR if existing schema or semantics change. Existing hex-codec-v1 deliberately excludes parser reproduction.

Independently review the bounded mechanism/proof design before executing authored parser or task fixtures. Then prove positive buggy-replay/fixed-pass behavior and wrong-input, fake/dead replay, swallowed/learner/late fault, omitted regression, misleading diagnosis and broken-valid-behavior controls through approved disposable execution before production activation or content admission.
